name: Rolling Taco
description: Playful food truck template where an SVG truck drives across the hero and a weekly route map draws itself between stops.
features: Illustrated taco truck driving along a dashed road in the hero
Self-drawing weekly route map with pins that pop in and link to the schedule
Taco menu cards, salsa heat levels and a combo deal banner
Catering pitch, FAQ, reviews and a working booking form
signature: A taco truck drives across the hero; the weekly stops map line draws itself between pins
